en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad Al jowhary, from Al Haris Bin Hareyz, from Sadeyr Al Sayrafi, from Abu Khalid Al Kalby who said,

‘I went over to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> called for the lunch. So I ate with him<sup>asws</sup> such food what I had not eaten at all, any cleaner than it, nor more aromatic. So when we were free from the meal, he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Khalid! How did you view your food?’, or said: ‘Our<sup>asws</sup> food?’’ I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! I have not seen better than it, nor any cleaner at all,
but I remember the Verse which is in the Book of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [102:8] Then on that Day you shall be Questioned about the Bounties’.
Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, but rather you would be Questioned what you are upon from the Truth’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah, from his father from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhariy from al-Harith ibn Hariz from Sadir al-Sayrafiy from abu Khalid al-Kabuliy who has said the following:

“I once visited abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam. He (the Imam) ordered food. I ate a food with him the like of which I never before had seen in cleanness and elegance. When we finished our food he (the Imam) asked, ‘O abu Khalid, how was your food’ or that he (the Imam) said, ‘Our food?’ I said, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, I had never seen such a food in delicacy and cleanness ever before;
but I remembered the verse which is in the book of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, ‘. . . on that day you will be asked about the bounties.’ [108:8]
Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘No, you will be asked only about the truth in which you are, (belief in the divine authority of ‘A’immah).”’
